{{Top|leg}}
'''Operation Searing Light''' was a two-part military operation carried out by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron and the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Battle of the Balosar system|destroyed]] an [[Balosar Outpost|Imperial]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in the [[Balosar system/Legends|Balosar system]], and [[Battle of Javaal|wiped out]] the Imperial squadron known as the [[Razor Shyracks]] at [[Javaal]].
